description: The blend kernels of the evaluator (04 section 3, task phase1.10_compositor-blend-kernels) for every documented BlendingMode, evaluated by the CPU store under the current profile on the Tier 0 blend sweeps and on the Normal channel. Residuals are |delta| in export units (16-bit PNG codes, OpenEXR float32 values) per texture set and channel, against both recordings (r1 same session, r2 after save and reopen). Supersedes blend-modes.json for the evaluator; blend-modes.json keeps the phase0.7 candidate fits.

entries.subject: BlendingMode.Normal in the evaluator
entries.formula: Normal, per channel in float32 (fma: one rounding): r = b. Opacity alpha (times the mask): over an opaque backdrop v = a (1 - alpha) + r alpha, the products rounded and summed in float32; over a transparent backdrop the source; else W3C §5.1. UNORM formats clamp r to [0, 1] first. Operands and writes per channel format as in quantisation-profile.json (isolated root, sRGB8 on linear values).

public_sources.locator: Floating-point rules: rcp, sqrt, rsqrt within 1 ULP; FLOAT to UNORM, FLOAT to FLOAT16

entries.subject: BlendingMode.Tint in the evaluator

entries.subject: BlendingMode.NormalMapCombine in the evaluator (user channels and the Normal channel)
entries.formula: NormalMapCombine: a, b = normalise(2c - 1) with z clamped to >= 0, normalise(v) = v rsqrt(fma(z, z, fma(x, x, y y))); b is first rotated toward (0, 0, 1) by the opacity (spherical interpolation, series in float32); whiteout r = (a.xy + b.xy, a.z b.z): t = base + (0, 0, 1), u = detail (-1, -1, 1), d = fma(t.z, u.z, fma(t.y, u.y, t.x u.x)), r.xy = fma(t.xy, d, -(u.xy t.z)), r.z = t.z (d - u.z); result fma(normalise(r), 1/2, 1/2), written as it is over an opaque backdrop (the opacity enters only through the rotation). A grey channel takes B. Divisions and roots use the recording GPU's float32 results (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, D3D12): the correctly rounded value moved by -2..+1 ulp from tables measured over every float32 mantissa (src/evaluator/hwmath.h; uzp-evaluator-tests fp-hardware), on the CPU and on every GPU alike.

entries.subject: BlendingMode.NormalMapInverseDetail in the evaluator (user channels and the Normal channel)
entries.formula: NormalMapInverseDetail: a, b = normalise(2c - 1) with z clamped to >= 0, normalise(v) = v rsqrt(fma(z, z, fma(x, x, y y))); b is first rotated toward (0, 0, 1) by the opacity (spherical interpolation, series in float32); reoriented normal mapping with base b, detail a: t = base + (0, 0, 1), u = detail (-1, -1, 1), d = fma(t.z, u.z, fma(t.y, u.y, t.x u.x)), r.xy = fma(t.xy, d, -(u.xy t.z)), r.z = t.z (d - u.z); result fma(normalise(r), 1/2, 1/2), written as it is over an opaque backdrop (the opacity enters only through the rotation). A grey channel takes B. Divisions and roots use the recording GPU's float32 results (NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090, D3D12): the correctly rounded value moved by -2..+1 ulp from tables measured over every float32 mantissa (src/evaluator/hwmath.h; uzp-evaluator-tests fp-hardware), on the CPU and on every GPU alike.

public_sources.locator: Blending in Detail: whiteout blending and reoriented normal mapping
Floating-point rules: rcp, sqrt, rsqrt within 1 ULP; FLOAT to UNORM, FLOAT to FLOAT16

entries.subject: BlendingMode.PassThrough (group layers only)
entries.formula: No kernel: a PassThrough group composites its visible children directly into the enclosing list with their opacities scaled by the group's (EVALUATOR.md). Not settable through Painter 12.1.0's API, so no Tier 0 golden records it.
